stages.description: 建立Pauli字串、係數、基底旋轉、樣本數及共變異假設五欄；不將可共同量測項當獨立。 依案例來源只註記可查證的裝置／方法；另以虛線標出本課新增的簡化假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Record Pauli strings, coefficients, basis rotations, shots and covariance assumptions; jointly measured terms are not automatically independent. Use the source only to label documented devices or methods; mark this exercise's simplifying assumptions with dashed connections.
